course_description:
Advanced Probability and statistics topics, not covered in other courses, and available only under special circumstances (for example, course to be given by a visiting lecturer in a specialty area that is not usually available). Endorsement of Head, Mathematics required for enrolment.

A Special Topics course provides the opportunity for independent directed study or a reading course under the supervision of a staff member.

Students should take special topics course only under special circumstances. In this case, their honours supervisor may advise the student as to which special topics might be helpful in relation to their research project.

In Semester 2, 2026, there are no special topics courses being offered in probability and statistics.

You might alternatively consider studying an AMSI (Australian Mathematical Sciences Institute) ACE subject. The subjects that will be offered for Semester 2, 2026 can be found at the following link

https://rhed.amsi.org.au/ace/#sem2

For more information about courses and opportunities with AMSI, contact Michael Jennings ( msj@maths.uq.edu.au ).

restrictions: Permission required to enrol. Please contact the School of Mathematics and Physics (smp.student@uq.edu.au).
